from pathlib import Path
Path('video/FINAL-REVIEW.md').write_text('''# Completed product video — 2026-10-12

The full Remotion `Main` composition covers all 11 scenes in 82 seconds. It retains the dark background, mascot expressions, bold typography, floating UI cards, blur dissolves, and the liked approval scene. Audio is music only; generated Kokoro assets are unused.

## What is included

| Time | Content |
| --- | --- |
| 0–11 s | Mascot introduction and Bot Company title |
| 11–27 s | Specialist delegation, real app screenshots, live token/cost counters |
| 27–35 s | Token cap, Approve/Deny controls, one-time extension |
| 35–40 s | Neat Bot introduction |
| 40–50 s | Employee ownership limits, admin access to all users, admin write approval |
| 50–62 s | Error trace, Northwind diagnosis, duplicated retrieval, ranked shared-context fix |
| 62–70 s | Before/after tokens and cost, status change, separate CFO file-read sample |
| 70–75 s | Real commit trail and Entire checkpoint |
| 75–82 s | Product end card and repository URL |

## Evidence and reconstruction

- Source images are the existing `docs/demo/evidence/2026-10-12` captures, copied into `video/public/evidence`. No new app recordings were made.
- Scene 5 pending approval controls are reconstructed from the real `web/src/shell/MessageBubble.tsx` and shot 21 numbers. The approved state is captured evidence from the same run. Shot 01 contributes styling, not its different cap values.
- Scene 7 is an illustrative motion graphic using generic users. Access rules and the exact ownership refusal were checked against `src/mastra/tools/neatlogs.ts`: employees see their own traces; admins have all-user access and project tools; writes require human approval. Showing all-user search does not grant an employee access.
- Scene 8 labels the live token-cap trace separately from the Northwind diagnosis. The highlight follows the observed failure, duplicated retrieval, and shared-context/output-cap recommendation. It does not claim every recommendation was implemented or that an empty Sales delegation caused the abort.
- Scene 9 uses one observed Northwind before/after trace pair: 323,923 → 237,208 tokens (−26.8%), $0.0589567 → $0.0498578 (−15.4%), ERROR → SUCCESS. Large cost counters are rounded to six decimals. The CFO reads 29 → 10 figure is a separate three-runs-per-group application-log sample, labelled observational. No general speed or benchmark claim is made.
- Scene 10 uses checkpoint `01M4QMYG0STA2ZQR90286XF297`, linked to commit `8887e9b`, and the actual prior cap/approval commits.
- Shots 22–23, which contain a runway miscalculation, are not used.

## Audio and reproducibility

The existing local music file is `public/music/raspberrymusic-the-last-point-beat-electronic-digital-394291.mp3`. Its source/credit is preserved in `STORYBOARD.md`; the standalone track remains gitignored. Fade-in is 0.65 s; fade-out is 1.2 s, relative to composition length.

From `video/`:

```sh
npm run typecheck
npm run render
npm run stills -- Main 1170,1470,1705,2055,2370
```

Render uses local port 3006, installed Remotion 4.0.535, and concurrency 2. No application source edits, commits, or pushes were made for this completion.

## Validation

- TypeScript: passed.
- Visual review: checked new scenes, admin approval fit, trace highlights, measured-result endpoints, checkpoint layout, end-card hold, and final black fade. Scenes 1–5 were already reviewed in Sprint 3.
- Final export/media validation: pending below.
''')
